sentences: A graph-removal statement links distance from excluding a fixed pattern to the number of copies of that pattern.
The saved question asks for sharp quantitative bounds in this relationship.
Such bounds control how likely random sampling is to discover a witness that a graph violates the property.
Improving them would directly sharpen the accuracy dependence of associated testing algorithms.
The title does not identify the pattern, induced versus ordinary copies, or the desired asymptotic precision, so it supports the quantitative direction without selecting a specific removal function.
